watches.name: AEGAON "ILMARINE" WHITE LTD
watches.description: Order yourself a piece of history, created in the spirit of Estonia’s 108th anniversary. The AEGAON “Ilmarine” LTD is part of a limited series in which no more than 300 pieces are produced exclusively based on pre-orders. All watches are individually numbered 001–300. Your number will be assigned at random and cannot be selected. Each watch is accompanied by a hand-signed certificate of authenticity, confirming its originality and place within the limited edition. The “Ilmarine” LTD is based on the AEGAON “Genesis 2.0” model. Inside its carefully finished stainless-steel case operates a Seiko VH31 quartz movement , manufactured by the Japanese watchmaker Seiko. The watch is fitted with a custom-made , exceptionally comfortable and high-quality genuine leather strap , produced by our longest-standing German partner, Di-Modell. For optics, the watch features anti-reflective sapphire crystal – its hardness requires the sharpness of a diamond to scratch. With a water resistance rating of 5 ATM, the watch is more than capable of withstanding everyday conditions—even the rainiest day at the Song Festival.

watches.name: GENESIS 2.0 quartz
watches.description: GENESIS 2.0 is a renewed and more powerful version of itself, where the mastery of Estonian design meets the precision of Japanese engineering. The highly accurate and reliable Seiko VH64 quartz movement offers more functions than before – including day and date display – with a setup that is easy to use. The movement belongs to Seiko’s sweep second series, recognisable by the smooth motion of the second hand, a feature usually found in mechanical timepieces. The greatest advantage of quartz, in addition to convenience, is its accuracy: while the typical deviation of a mechanical watch is about ±15 seconds per day, this watch deviates by ±15 seconds per month. This highly esteemed movement breathes new life into our bestselling Genesis design, first introduced in 2021. The dial has been completely redesigned – for the first time in AEGAON’s history, we see large and highly legible numerals as hour markers. Thanks to strong luminescence , they remain visible even in the dark. The smooth lines of the case make Genesis 2.0 one of the most comfortable watches to wear on a daily basis. Whether you prefer a classic leather strap, an elegant metal or mesh bracelet, a sporty rubber band – Genesis 2.0 provides every comfort without compromising on its exceptional look.

watches.name: NEW "GENESIS 48" automatic
watches.description: First step is what it takes to get things going. It is a force that sets in motion all the key elements in your life – relationships, career, training, dreams, even children and this watch. it is the force, that marks all beginnings – “Genesis”. AEGAON “Genesis” automatic is a new generation mechanical watch that meets the expectations of all past, present and future environmentally conscious generations – meaning no electronics, batteries or mindless waste. That’s why we present to you one of the most important inventions of the 18-th century, a modern version of the self-winding automatic movement. It is a fine machinery that feeds on kinetic energy only you produce by just moving. It takes only 15 minutes of daily activity to power the watch for the next two days. You can always add power by manually winding the crown. The beauty of this technology can be observed through scratch proof sapphire optics on both sides of the casing, that is made of the most durable stainless steel. The modern design line of the watch brings you the benefit of both courteous and sporty look, that sits comfortably on your wrist with the elegant rubber band. Meaning there is no need to draw a line between the formal and real “you”.
